About Stephen Curry

Stephen Curry is a 38-year-old American professional basketball player who plays at the Point Guard or Shooting Guard position for the Golden State Warriors in the NBA. He is 6 feet 2 inches (188cm) tall, weighs 185 pounds (83kg), and has a wingspan of 6 feet 4 inches (193cm).

Steph played college basketball at Davidson College. He joined the Davidson Wildcats for the 2006-2007 season and played through the 2008-2009 season. During his time at Davidson, he became known for his exceptional shooting ability and scoring prowess. He quickly gained national attention for his long-range shooting and his ability to score in various ways. He declared for the NBA Draft after three years in college. He was selected as the 7th overall pick by the Golden State Warriors in the 2009 NBA Draft.

For the 2025-26 NBA season, Stephen Curry's base salary is $59,606,817.

Stephen Curry on NBA 2K26

On NBA 2K26, the Current Version of Stephen Curry has an Overall 2K Rating of 95 with a Crafty Offensive Engine Build. He has a total of 21 Badges in which 6 of them are Hall of Fame Level and 9 are Gold Level. The best aspect of Curry's game on 2K is his Outside Scoring. With a lethal 99 Three-Point Shot Rating, he is very dangerous from deep even with just a bit of shooting space on the floor. Additionally, his great 97 Ball Handle Rating allows him to get an open shot despite tight defense on him.

The above line graph shows his NBA 2K26 Rating Season Movement while below are his Attributes, Badges, Hot Zones and 2K Rating Over the Years.

This current version of Stephen Curry was also selected to play for Western Conference All-Stars and USA FIBA Team.
